probe_configuration:
# ── Global ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

php-version = "8.1"
editor-url = "phpstorm://open?file=%file%&line=%line%&column=%column%"

# ── Source Discovery ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[source]
paths = ["tests/Support/ToolingProbes/Probe.php"]
includes = ["src", "vendor", "tests/Fixtures/mate"]
excludes = []

# ── Formatter ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[formatter]
excludes = ["tests/Fixtures"] # vendored upstream fixtures and Mate source, kept verbatim
# Tuned to match the Laravel Pint style the codebase was written in.

# ┌─ Layout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
print-width = 1000 # Pint has no line-length limit; never wrap on width alone
tab-width = 4
use-tabs = false
end-of-line = "lf"

# ┌─ Strings & Trailing Commas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
single-quote = true
trailing-comma = true

# ┌─ Brace Styles ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
classlike-brace-style = "always-next-line"
method-brace-style = "next-line"
function-brace-style = "next-line"
control-brace-style = "same-line"
closure-brace-style = "same-line"
following-clause-on-newline = false
inline-empty-method-braces = false
inline-empty-constructor-braces = true
inline-empty-anonymous-class-braces = true

# ┌─ Preserve existing line breaks ─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
preserve-breaking-member-access-chain = true
preserve-breaking-argument-list = true
preserve-breaking-array-like = true
preserve-breaking-parameter-list = true
preserve-breaking-attribute-list = true
preserve-breaking-conditional-expression = true
preserve-breaking-condition-expression = true
preserve-breaking-binary-expression = true
method-chain-breaking-style = "same-line"
first-method-chain-on-new-line = false

# ┌─ Spacing & Parentheses (Laravel preset) ────────────────────────────────────┐
space-around-concatenation-binary-operator = false
space-after-cast-unary-prefix-operators = true
space-after-logical-not-unary-prefix-operator = true
space-before-closure-parameter-list-parenthesis = true
space-before-closure-use-clause-parenthesis = true
space-before-arrow-function-parameter-list-parenthesis = true
space-around-assignment-in-declare = false
space-within-grouping-parenthesis = false
parentheses-in-new-expression = false
preserve-redundant-logical-binary-expression-parentheses = true
omit-redundant-arithmetic-binary-expression-parentheses = true

# ┌─ Imports / Use Statements ──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
sort-uses = true
separate-use-types = true
expand-use-groups = true

# ┌─ Blank Lines ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
empty-line-after-opening-tag = true
empty-line-after-namespace = true
empty-line-after-use = true
empty-line-after-method = true
empty-line-before-return = true
empty-line-after-control-structure = false
separate-class-like-members = true
empty-line-after-symbols = true

# ┌─ Alignment & Arrays ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
array-table-style-alignment = false
align-assignment-like = false

# ┌─ Type Hints & Misc ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
uppercase-literal-keyword = false
null-type-hint = "question"
remove-trailing-close-tag = true
indent-heredoc = false

# ── Analyzer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[analyzer]
check-missing-type-hints = true
minimum-fail-level = "warning"
ignore = [
    "mixed-assignment",
    # These read spec fixtures from JSON, so values are untyped by nature
    { code = "mixed-argument", in = ["tests/VersionedFixturesTest.php", "tests/Support/capture-legacy.php"] },
    { code = "mixed-operand", in = ["tests/VersionedFixturesTest.php", "tests/Support/capture-legacy.php"] },
    { code = "mixed-property-access", in = ["tests/VersionedFixturesTest.php", "tests/Support/capture-legacy.php"] },
    { code = "mixed-array-access", in = ["tests/VersionedFixturesTest.php", "tests/Support/capture-legacy.php"] },
    { code = "invalid-iterator", in = ["tests/VersionedFixturesTest.php", "tests/Support/capture-legacy.php"] },
    { code = "possibly-false-argument", in = ["tests/VersionedFixturesTest.php", "tests/Support/capture-legacy.php"] },
    { code = "possibly-false-iterator", in = ["tests/VersionedFixturesTest.php", "tests/Support/capture-legacy.php"] },
    { code = "possibly-null-argument", in = ["tests/VersionedFixturesTest.php", "tests/Support/capture-legacy.php"] },
    { code = "possibly-undefined-string-array-index", in = ["tests/VersionedFixturesTest.php", "tests/Support/capture-legacy.php"] },
]

# ── Linter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

[linter]
excludes = ["tests/Fixtures"]
minimum-fail-level = "warning"
integrations = ["php-unit"]

[linter.rules]
# Enforce declare(strict_types=1) at the beginning of files
strict-types = { enabled = true, level = "Error" }
assertion-style = { style = "this" } # in phpunit tests
strict-assertions = { enabled = false } # assertSame would change semantics of existing tests
literal-named-argument = { enabled = false }
no-empty = { enabled = false }
no-insecure-comparison = { enabled = false } # false positives on token comparisons in the decoder
too-many-methods = { enabled = false } # triggers too much in test classes
excessive-parameter-list = { enabled = false } # option objects
single-class-per-file = { enabled = false } # tests define fixture enums inline
readable-literal = { enabled = false }
no-ini-set = { enabled = false } # the 4.4 float encoder pins serialize_precision for the call and restores it
# Size/complexity metrics: the parser and encoder are intentionally monolithic state machines
cyclomatic-complexity = { enabled = false }
kan-defect = { enabled = false }
halstead = { enabled = false }
